readout_other: Fluo-4 and GCaMP calcium imaging; propidium iodide membrane integrity assay
direction_notes: A single pulse evoked calcium responses in about 20% of pharmacologically disconnected neurons; the response was abolished by TTX and was larger at 0.65-0.67 MPa than at 0.35 MPa.

timing.protocol_description: Cultures were exposed to a single ultrasound pulse per stimulation (4 ms or 40 ms; 0.35 to 1.32 MPa peak pressure) with calcium images acquired for 5 s before and 10 s after; repeated stimulations were separated by recovery periods.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: We used single pulses, a fundamental frequency of 500 kHz, peak pressures of 0.35e1.32 MPa, and durations of 4 ms-40 ms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: We used single pulses, a fundamental frequency of 500 kHz, peak pressures of 0.35e1.32 MPa, and durations of 4 ms-40 ms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: We used single pulses, a fundamental frequency of 500 kHz, peak pressures of 0.35e1.32 MPa, and durations of 4 ms-40 ms.
source_quotes.n_subjects: There were typically \~200 generally active cells within the FOV (191.4 ± 10.2, mean ± SEM, n<sup>c</sup> 78).

flags.reason: Paper says a 2-cycle pulse at 500 kHz corresponds to '4 ms'; 2 cycles at 500 kHz is 4 microseconds, so the unit may be a typo. Recorded as written (4 ms and 40 ms).
Peak pressures of 0.35 to 1.32 MPa; the text says output was verified with a hydrophone in a large water tank. Other text gives 0.65, 0.67 MPa for the higher pressure.
78 is the number of cultures (n^c) in the generally-active-cell count; the equals sign was lost in conversion. Total cultures across experiments is not stated.
Transducer maker and model not given in the main text (methods are in the supplementary).
Single short pulses, one per stimulation; recorded as continuous per the single-burst rule.
